name: eeprom-fast-read
summary: Read the settings EEPROM with 2 us instead of 4 us clock half-periods (~200 kHz; FM24C128D is rated 1 MHz); writes unchanged

notes: sub_240134 is the bit-banged I2C read-bit routine and is only reached from the EEPROM block read (sub_2403B5). Worst case if the EEPROM misread: settings reload to defaults (user area only); the factory area 0x1794-0x1C2F is never written by normal code and a checksum failure there only loads defaults into RAM.
